1983-06-13 Hit Factory (The), New York City, NY

Share:

Info & Setlist | Venue

Recording session for Born In The U.S.A. The released version of "TV Movie" was recorded at this session. Overdub/mix elements used for the released versions of "None But The Brave" and "Unsatisfied Heart" may also have recorded on this date, potentially including Steven Van Zandt's guitar part on the former and Max Weinberg's drums and synthesizer from Roy Bittan on the latter.
